title: Agent Identity RP abuse report claims (agent-rp-abuse+jwt)
description: Contract D.2 (v1.2) authenticated abuse report claims. Header: {alg: EdDSA, typ: agent-rp-abuse+jwt, kid}. Signed by an RP key that is present in the accompanying attestation `keys[]` with `abuse` in purposes. `exp - iat` MUST equal exactly 300 seconds and the broker accepts the report only within [iat - 60s, exp]; the five-minute freshness bound is never extended. Reports are current events (unlike receipts, which are historical facts) and are idempotent on `jti`. Normative definition: agent-identity-v1.md §11.

iss.description: RP origin. MUST equal the accompanying attestation `rp.origin`.

jti.description: Report id: `abr_` + 26-character lowercase Crockford base32 ULID. Idempotency key.

reason.description: Free-text reason, 1-500 characters. Never includes secrets or credentials.

evidence.description: OPTIONAL pointers to the signup the report is about.
